output.reasoning_summary:
The claim states that Coca-Cola's operating margin for fiscal year 2025 exceeded 25%. Evidence E2 explicitly shows the consolidated operating margin for the year ended December 31, 2025 was 28.7%, which exceeds 25%. 

Challenge H1 questioned whether one-time items affected the 28.7% figure. The evidence shows that operating margin is calculated after considering "other operating charges" (E1), and that 2025 actually benefited from LOWER other operating charges compared to 2024, which had a significant fairlife-related charge (E2). This means the 28.7% figure is the GAAP operating margin that includes all charges, and if anything, 2024 was more affected by one-time items than 2025. This refutes the challenge.

Challenge H2 sought evidence of an adjusted or non-GAAP operating margin. No such alternative measure was found in the retrieved evidence for fiscal year 2025.

Challenge H3 sought evidence of restatements or corrections. No such evidence was found.

The initial verdict of SUPPORTED remains correct. The 28.7% operating margin for fiscal year 2025 is clearly stated and exceeds the 25% threshold in the claim.
